description: This file contains functions related to URL parsing and validation, including checking URL schemes, decoding URL components, and ensuring URL strings end with a slash.

methods.name: int is_urlschemechar(int first_flag,int ch)
methods.description: Checks if a character is valid in a URL scheme, considering position in the scheme (first or subsequent character).

methods.name: int is_url(const char * url)
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a properly formatted URL with scheme and '://' delimiter.

methods.name: char * url_decode(const char * url)
methods.description: Decodes a URL, handling percent-encoding and optional protocol prefix.

methods.name: char * url_decode_mem(const char * url,int len)
methods.description: Decodes a URL from a memory buffer with specified length, handling percent-encoding and protocol prefix.

methods.name: char * url_percent_decode(const char * encoded)
methods.description: Decodes a string with percent-encoded characters.

methods.name: char * url_decode_parameter_name(const char ** query)
methods.description: Decodes URL parameter names, stopping at '&' or '='.

methods.name: char * url_decode_parameter_value(const char ** query)
methods.description: Decodes URL parameter values, stopping at '&'.

methods.name: void end_url_with_slash(struct strbuf * buf,const char * url)
methods.description: Appends a slash to a URL string buffer, ensuring it ends with a slash.

methods.name: void str_end_url_with_slash(const char * url,char ** dest)
methods.description: Creates a URL string with a trailing slash, replacing the destination string if necessary.
